projects.name: stb-image-opt
projects.lead: Fork of stb_image v2.30 with AVX2 JPEG IDCT and YCbCr paths and a PNG speedup; sibling of the listed stb-image-resize-opt (lead from its enricher). Look for the bench harness, flags, CPU and output-identity check against upstream stb_image.

projects.name: stb-image-write-opt
projects.lead: Optimised fork of stb_image_write by the same author; find its benchmark against upstream stb_image_write and whether outputs are byte-identical.

projects.name: intel-tex-rs-2
projects.lead: Rust bindings plus sped-up ISPC texture-compression kernels; PR #50 (merged 2026-09-28) claims BC7 2.1-6.2x faster than Intel ispc_texcomp. Document the PR numbers, machine and ISPC version.

projects.name: bc7enc_rdo
projects.lead: Maintained successor of the listed bc7enc and bc7e (RDO BC1-7); check its README tables against ispc_texcomp, bc7e and Compressonator for machine, compiler and flags.

projects.name: astc-encoder
projects.lead: ARM astcenc 2.x-5.x; the changelog charts claim 2-4x over astcenc 1.7 at near-equal PSNR (i5-9600K, 6 threads). Document the strongest versioned comparison; the baseline is its own older version unless a third-party comparison exists.

projects.name: jpegli
projects.lead: Google improved JPEG encoder and decoder with the libjpeg62 API and ABI; find any speed numbers against libjpeg-turbo (blog, docs, issues). If only quality claims exist, tier D.

projects.name: mozjpeg
projects.lead: Baseline of the listed mozjpeg-rs and a libjpeg-turbo fork with trellis quantisation; usually slower than libjpeg-turbo but smaller files. Record its documented speed and size trade-off versus libjpeg-turbo with versions.

projects.name: GPUJPEG
projects.lead: CUDA JPEG encoder and decoder (BSD-2); look for throughput numbers against libjpeg-turbo or nvJPEG with GPU model; parallel Huffman decode needs restart markers.

projects.name: AnimatedGIF
projects.lead: Same Turbo LZW decoder as the listed giflib-turbo, MCU-oriented; the README claims 2-30x faster decoding. Find any table, harness or machine behind it.

projects.name: PNGenc
projects.lead: Embedded PNG encoder by the same author; check for speed claims against libpng or lodepng and the evidence behind them.

projects.name: qoi-asm
projects.lead: x86-64 assembly drop-in for qoi.h claiming 1.07-2.16x over gcc -O3 on an i7-14700F; 1 commit, 0 stars. Record the harness, flags and whether outputs are byte-identical to qoi.h.

projects.name: rusty_jpeg
projects.lead: Rust JPEG codec from the Remade-With-Rust group with first-party numbers against FFmpeg; check thread settings, timers and output MD5 against FFmpeg as the sibling entries required.

projects.name: rusty_gif
projects.lead: Rust GIF codec from the same group; same checks as rusty_jpeg.

projects.name: jpeg-encoder
projects.lead: Pure-Rust JPEG encoder with AVX2 (MIT/Apache); look for any benchmark against libjpeg-turbo, mozjpeg or the image crate. If none, tier D.

projects.name: libqoi
projects.lead: C++ QOI implementation whose issue #1 claims 20-30% over the listed qoixx; find the numbers and harness or tier D.

projects.name: bcdec
projects.lead: Single-header BC1-7 decoder; check for any speed comparison against DirectXTex, Compressonator or bc7enc decoders.

projects.name: skcms
projects.lead: Google colour management system used by Skia and Chromium; look for throughput numbers against Little-CMS (design docs, commit messages, Chromium bugs) with machine and build; Little-CMS fast_float is already listed.

projects.name: libblur
projects.lead: Rust blur library with a C API; README claims box blur 3000x4000 r77 in 3.71 ms versus OpenCV 15.73 ms on NEON. Record the table, harness, toolchain and whether OpenCV ran its SIMD paths; the same author wrote the listed sparkyuv and yuvutils-rs, whose harnesses had stride and label bugs.

projects.name: FastGaussianBlur
projects.lead: Fast Gaussian blur approximation (128 stars); find any numeric comparison against OpenCV GaussianBlur or ImageMagick; if none, tier D.

projects.name: kornia-rs
projects.lead: Rust computer-vision kernels proposed as an OpenCV replacement in Albumentations issue #1584; look for resize, colour-conversion or JPEG decode benchmarks against OpenCV or Pillow with machine and versions (a snippet cites 1034 versus 775 images per second for JPEG decode).

projects.name: go-gfx
projects.lead: Go resample and colour kernels used by the listed go-images; look for benchmarks against golang.org/x/image or OpenCV.

projects.name: pic-scale
projects.lead: Rust image scaler by the sparkyuv author with SIMD paths; find its README comparison against fast_image_resize, libvips or OpenCV and check the harness as for libblur.

projects.name: scanx
projects.lead: Go anti-aliased scanner (beta, 2019) whose README gives ImgSpanner 513 ms versus FTScanner 1645 ms versus GVScanner (x/image/vector) 38,053 ms at 5x; the default rasteriser of the listed tdewolff/canvas. Record the harness and machine.

projects.name: plutovg
projects.lead: Tiny C vector rasteriser (FreeType ftgrays lineage) behind the listed LunaSVG; look for any speed comparison against Cairo, Skia or Blend2D.

projects.name: vvdec
projects.lead: Fraunhofer VVC decoder, sibling of the listed VVenC; look for decode speed against OpenVVC, FFmpeg FFVVC or VTM with CPU, threads and clips (papers are blocked here, so use the README, wiki and issues).

projects.name: hmp3
projects.lead: Helix MP3 encoder revival (38 stars); find any encode-speed comparison against LAME or Shine; if none, tier D.

projects.name: soundkit (soundkit-opus)
projects.lead: Successor crate of the listed libopus-rs (soundkit-opus 0.13.0, MIT AND BSD-3-Clause); its performance-results directory holds same-packet re-tests against libopus. Record the current encode and decode ratios, machine and flags.

projects.name: KNLMeansCL
projects.lead: OpenCL non-local-means denoiser (C++) for VapourSynth and AviSynth; look for fps comparisons against FFmpeg nlmeans or nlmeans_opencl with GPU model.

projects.name: VapourSynth-BM3DCUDA
projects.lead: BM3D and V-BM3D denoisers on CUDA and HIP; look for fps or speedup against the CPU BM3D plugin or FFmpeg bm3d with GPU and CPU models.

projects.name: sst-basic-blocks (Surge LanczosResampler)
projects.lead: Paul Walker Lanczos resampler used by Surge; a NonIntegerSRC issue #4 user reports it about 2x faster than sinc resampling. Find any numeric comparison against libsamplerate or r8brain; if none, tier D.

projects.name: uax29
projects.lead: Go grapheme, word and sentence segmentation (UAX #29); the dependency behind the listed go-runewidth baseline and displaywidth. Record its README benchmarks against rivo/uniseg or golang.org/x/text with Go version and CPU.

projects.name: libmsdf
projects.lead: Rust wgpu multi-channel signed-distance-field generator; look for any comparison against msdfgen or the listed msdfgl; if none, tier D.

projects.name: ConvectionKernels (BC6H/BC7 texture codec)
projects.lead: Fastest BC6H decoder in aras-p's 2022 charts (aras-p/aras-p.hugo static/img/blog/2022/bcn-decode-*.png, harness aras-p/bcn_decoder_tester); label chart readings as derived.

projects.name: JPEGDEC (bitbank2)
projects.lead: Progressive JPEG decode at 1/8 scale in about 18 KB of constant memory; check README speed tables and the Wiki (MCU-oriented); tier D if only claims.

projects.name: rusty_webp (Remade-With-Rust)
projects.lead: Lead text: 'remade_ffmpeg_rs crates/rusty_webp'; confirm the actual repo path (sibling repos Remade-With-Rust/rusty_gif and rusty_jpeg are catalogued) and set repo_url to the repo that holds rusty_webp; claims unchecked.

projects.name: honeydiff (Rust pixel diff)
projects.lead: Rust, MIT, 14 stars; rival to the catalogued odiff; the repo page may show only JS loader files (binary-only); find benchmark numbers or record D.

projects.name: zenquant (imazen palette quantizer)
projects.lead: Rust, AGPL-3.0 plus commercial (reference unless the licence is dual); compares against imagequant and quantette in its README or benches.

projects.name: Simd (ermig1979)
projects.lead: C++ SIMD image processing library; its benchmark pages live on ermig1979.github.io (blocked), fetch them through raw.githubusercontent.com of the ermig1979/ermig1979.github.io repo if it exists, else docs/ in the repo.

projects.name: BoofCV
projects.lead: Java; its Performance:OpenCV:BoofCV page has numbers (boofcv.org blocked); the benchmark code is lessthanoptimal/SpeedTestCV; label ratios derived.

projects.name: Canvas-Txt v5
projects.lead: bench/compare.mjs and issue #13: 51.3 vs 566.2 us/op against canvas-hypertxt standard mode on never-repeating 600-char strings (about 11x, node-canvas, Apple Silicon); canvas-hypertxt is catalogued.

projects.name: vapoursynth-nssfactory (CUDA BM3D)
projects.lead: First-party PR #23 numbers beat bm3dcuda on an RTX 5080 (732 vs 636 fps); BM3DCUDA is catalogued; 1 star.

projects.name: scany (multi-threaded scanner, srwiley)
projects.lead: Multi-threaded ScanT by the scanx author (scanx catalogued); check README numbers.

projects.name: clownresampler
projects.lead: Single-header integer windowed-sinc resampler; search snippets only so far; tier D if the repo has no numbers.
